# Vendored dependencies

Airnode helper source and MIT license copied without changes from
https://github.com/api3dao/airnodehub-hackathon-starter at
`52933ae1fb9371446a927338473466c3d320e19a` (31 October 2026).

The starter pins these dependency revisions. This repository includes their source, without embedded Git checkouts:

- OpenZeppelin Contracts v5.7.0 `cab19933c33c2ad1d4c7a84864a3601dddfd16f3`, MIT.
- Solady v0.1.26 `acd959aa4bd04720d640bf4e6a5c71037510cc4b`, MIT.
- Forge Standard Library v1.17.0 `f3dae6e6ee381f25eb6a246f7da9b85c91a68219`, MIT/Apache-2.0.

Licenses are next to each vendored package. The attestation verifier is the official helper; application policy resides in `DividendBond.sol`.
